# Snaprint

> Snaprint turns xerox/photocopy shops into 24/7 self-service print kiosks. Students and customers scan a QR code, upload a document, pay, and collect the print — no queue, no shop owner needed to operate it. Built by Sanskriti Labs for shop owners in Bengaluru, India.

Snaprint is a hardware + software print kiosk product (the "S1" machine) sold to xerox/photocopy shop owners as a way to serve customers outside staffed hours and reduce queue time.

Full description, FAQ, and structured data: https://snaprints.com/llms-full.txt

## Core pages

- [Home](https://snaprints.com/): Product overview, how it works, the S1 machine, pricing/demo contact.
- [Book a Demo](https://snaprints.com/book): Schedule a live walkthrough of the S1 kiosk with the founding team.
- [Instant Print — all cities](https://snaprints.com/instant-print): Hub listing every city with verified xerox and print shops.
- [Print Near You — colleges and neighbourhoods](https://snaprints.com/print-near): Hub listing every college and neighbourhood with verified xerox and print shops.
- [Blog](https://snaprints.com/blog): Operator guides, comparison pieces, and student use-case explainers.
